drivingQuestion: Does the mishna's 'adjacent to minha' refer to the greater or the lesser minha?
outcomeNote: The dilemma is only raised here; it is elaborated and resolved in the next unit.

segments.he: סָמוּךְ לַמִּנְחָה. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: סָמוּךְ לְמִנְחָה גְּדוֹלָה תְּנַן, אוֹ דִילְמָא סָמוּךְ לְמִנְחָה קְטַנָּה תְּנַן?
segments.en: The Gemara returns to the mishna, which stated that it is prohibited to eat «adjacent to minḥa time» on Passover eve. «A dilemma was raised before» the Sages in the study hall: Did «we learn» in the mishna that it is prohibited to eat «adjacent to» the time of the «greater minḥa [minḥa gedola],» which is half an hour after midday, «or perhaps we learned» in the mishna that it is prohibited to eat «adjacent to» the time of the «lesser minḥa [minḥa ketana],» two and a half hours before sunset?
